    A local criterion for cleaving functors out of path categories #

    If P has cancellation, a functor F : PathCat Q ⥤ P is cleaving as soon as it is nonzero and injective on paths and satisfies Gabriel–Roiter's condition b) of 13.8 for the arrows: if F p factors through F e on the side of an arrow e, then p starts (resp. ends) with e (RayCat.PathCat.isCleaving_of_arrows).

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.PathCat.ArrowCleaving {Q : Type} [Quiver Q] {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor (PathCat Q) P) :
    Prop

    The hypotheses of the local criterion.

    • ne_zero {a b : Q} (p : Quiver.Path a b) : F.map (ofPath p) ≠ 0
    • injective {a b : Q} (p q : Quiver.Path a b) : F.map (ofPath p) = F.map (ofPath q) → p = q
    • left {a c b : Q} (e : a ⟶ c) (p : Quiver.Path a b) : (∃ (g : F.obj { as := c } ⟶ F.obj { as := b }), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.map (ofPath e.toPath)) g = F.map (ofPath p)) → ∃ (q : Quiver.Path c b), p = e.toPath.comp q
    • right {a c b : Q} (e : c ⟶ b) (p : Quiver.Path a b) : (∃ (g : F.obj { as := a } ⟶ F.obj { as := c }), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (F.map (ofPath e.toPath)) = F.map (ofPath p)) → ∃ (q : Quiver.Path a c), p = q.cons e
